# MyChama

> MyChama is chama (Kenyan savings and investment group) management software by Samuhia: one offline-ready, installable web app for members, contributions, loans, merry-go-round rotations, M-Pesa and Paystack collections, bulk SMS, meeting minutes and financial reports. Free plan available; paid plans priced in KES per month.

MyChama does not hold chama funds — online payments are processed by Paystack and settle to the chama's own account. The public site is a single landing page; the signed-in app lives under /app and is private.

## Key pages

- [Home — overview, features and how it works](https://chama.samuhia.co.ke/): what MyChama does and who it is for
- [Pricing](https://chama.samuhia.co.ke/#pricing): plans from Free to Max, in KES per month
- [FAQ](https://chama.samuhia.co.ke/#faq): safety of funds, offline use, loans, merry-go-round, reports, SMS
- [Get the app](https://chama.samuhia.co.ke/#get-the-app): install on Android, iPhone or desktop — no app store needed
